memory_candidates: A plan bullet's `#eval decide (X)` verification criterion silently settles an offered Prop-vs-Bool definition choice: `decide` only typechecks on the Prop spelling, so the criterion, not the bullet's prose, is the binding constraint.

A 'route through the existing transitivity / per-arm membership lemmas' plan hint can be directionally unsatisfiable: per-arm subformula lemmas CONSTRUCT a membership, while an inheritance proof must DESTRUCTURE one. Mirroring the transitivity proof's own arm-for-arm shape satisfies what the hint protected (re-deriving no project lemma) without using it.
